description: Birakenewe kumenya amazina yerekana amamuko y’Umwami Yesu mu bari mw’isi. Benshi barasoma Bibiliya ariko iy’aya mazina bakabisimba, ariko na vyo ni Bibiliya. Muri ayo mazina turabona mwo amazina y’abagore kandi bari abanyamahanga mbere abanyavyaha mugabo batahuye bakizera ibitangaza vy’Imana. Yosefu na Mariya, bose bava mu ru vyaro raAburahamu
name: Amazina ya ba sekuruza ba Yesu

description: Yesu bamwereka ukuntu bafise urusengero rwiza, arababwira ati uru ruzosambuka ntihazozigara n’ibuye rigeretse ku rindi. N’igisagara ca Yerusalemu kizosangangurwa, gisiribangwe n’abanyamahanga. Ivyo vyabaye mu mwaka wa 70 aho Abaroma batera I Yerusalemu. Aravuga yuko mu bihe vy’iherezo hzoba amarushwa mensh n’abigisha b’ibinyoma.
name: Ibimenyetso vy’uguhona kw’I Yerusalemu

description: Hari ibindi bimenyetso Yesu yerekanye vy’uguhona kw’I Yerusalemu n’ukugaruka kwiwe. -ubutumwa bwiza kuvugwa hose, -ikizir c’ubuyobe gihagaze ahera. Ati hazoba amarushwa menshi atigeze kubaho. Kandi hazoza abiyita Kristo benshi kand bazozimiza benshi. Hanyuma y’ayo marushwa zoba rizocura umwiza, ukwezi ntikwake, inyenyeri zikoragurike, n’ivy’inkomezi vyo mu majuru binyiganyizwe
name: Ibindi bimenyetso vy’igihe co kugaruka kwa Yesu

description: Yesu yakijije umukobwa w’mukuru w’isinagogi adendutse. Yaciye akiza umugore amaze imyaka ibiri ari mu ngorane z’ubutinyanka. Yakoze ku mpuzu ya Yesu mu kwizera, aca arakira.
name: Ibindi bitangaza bibiri

description: Hari ibitangaza vyinshi Yesu yakoze ariko bitaciye vyandikwa muri Bibiliya. Hano turabona ibi bitangaza: guhwamika inkubi y’umuyaga mu kiyaga, gusenda abadayimoni, gukiza ikimuga ashitse I Gadara.
name: Ibindi bitangaza Yesu yakoze

description: Ngaha turabona ukuntu yakoze ibitangaza amanutse umusozi: gukiza umunyamibembe, umushumba w’umugabisha w’abasoda, inabukwe wa Petero, umuntu yinjiwemwo n’abadayimoni
name: Ibitangaza Yesu yakoze amanutse umusozi

description: Yesu yabatumye abigishwa biwe 12 mu gihugu abahaye ububasha ku mpwemu mbi n’ubwo gukora ibitangaza. Arababwira ati ntimutware umupfuko w’amahera. Yagomba yuko batokwitwararika ubwa mbere ivyo kurondera amahera. Yari azi ko bazohura n’ingorane ariko arabaremesha, abibutsa ko imbere yabo hari ubugingo budashira.
name: Igikorwa c’intumwa mu gihugu ca Isirayeli

description: Kuva ku muhanuzi wa nyuma ari we Malaki kugeza ku butumwa bwa Matayo haciye ikiringo c’agacerere c’imyaka 400. Muri ico kiringo c’imyaka 400, ni ho havutse imice y’Abafarisayo, Absadukayo n’Abanyabenge b’ivyanditswe, n’Abaherode. Muri ico gihe ni ho Igitabo c’Isezerano ryakera ryahindura mu Kigiriki. Ubutuma bwa Matayo ahanini bandikiwe Abisirayeli n’abanyamadini bose bo mu bwoko b’Abisirayeli. Muri ubu butuma ni ho havuga cane ivy’ubami bwo mw’ijuru.
name: Ikiringo c’agacerere imbere yuko ubutumwa bwa Matayo bwandikwa

description: Abafarisayo babonye ko abigishwa ba Yesu batanguye kumyoza ingano bakazihekenya. Ati ntibarenze ivyagezwe vy’isabato nabiziruye kugira ngo bashire inzara, kandi ndi Umwami w’Isabato. Na bo bati ararogose. Kandi akiza umuntu kw’Isabato baca barababara. Ariko abereka yuko gushikira ineza y’umuntu biruta kwubahiriza imigenzo. Baguma barondera urwitwazo rwo kumufata arabahunga ariko abantu benshi baramukurikira, na we akiza benshi cane.
name: Impari hagati ya Yesu n’abarongozi b’idini

description: Yesu bamuzaniye abana baton go abahezagire, abigishwa bakagomba kubigizayo, ariko Yesu ati ni mureke abana bato baze aho ndi kuko ubwami bwo mw;ijuru ai ubw’abameze n’abo. Turarangiriza ku nkuru y’umusore w’umutunzi yaje kubaza Yesu
name: Ingene Yesu yakiriye abana bato

description: Abafarisayo n’abanyabwenge bamusaba ibimenyetso, na we ati ab’urunganwe rubi basaba ibimenyetso ariko nta kindi kimenyetso bazobona Atari n’ica Yona. Yamaze imisi itatu mu nda y’urufi. Uwuruta Yona na Salomo ari ngaha. Yesu arerekana abavukanyi biwe vy’ukuri ab’ari bo. Ni abakora ivyo Imana igomba. Turabona umugani w’umubivyi werekabna yuko imbuto ari ijambo ry’Imana. Ivu ryiza ni imitima y’abiteguye kwakira ijambo bakizera
name: Inyigisho nyinshi z’ubwai bwo mw’ijuru.

description: Izo nyigisho zivuga ku bizoba. Ni inzira ifasha gushika ku mukiza yadupfiriye. Zivuga abahirwe abo ari bo Zerekana imigenderanire y’abari mu bwami bw’Imana n’iyo Mana nyene. Iri jambo ngo “hahirwa” rikoreshejwe incuro 9. Icogufasha gushitsa ibi vyose bisabwa ngo ube uwuhiriwe nuko woba wihanye ivyaha ukaba muri Yesu Kristo ibindi vyose Mpwemu Yera akagufasha kubishitsa
name: Inyigisho za Yesu ku musozi.

description: Yesu amaze kumenyesha abigishwa biwe yuko badakwiye kurwanira ubukuru mu bwami bwo mw’ijuru, akora igitangaza co guhumura impumyi zibiri, ashika I Yerusalemu ai ku nyana y’indogoba yinjira mu rusengero asanga abaruhumanisha urudandazwa arabirukana
name: Ivy’ubukuru n’icubahiro vya Yesu

description: Yesu aravuga ati umuntu akugiriye nabi umwihererane mwumvikane, akunaniye uzane icabona, canke bibiri canke bitatu. Vyanse bishikirizwe ishengero. Ati kandi uwugufitiye umwenda ntuce utsindaho. Mu nyuma arigisha ko kwahukana bitabereye.
name: Ivy’uguharirana, no kwirinda kwahukana

description: Mu gatututuru k’umusi ugira gatatu Yesu ahambwe, umumarayika w’Imana aramanuka atembagaza ca kibuye cari cugaye imva, Habaho gutigita kw’isi gukomeye, Yesu ava mu mva ari muzima, yiyereka abigishwa biwe. Aja iGalilaya yiyereka abigishwa biwe aca abasigarana igikorwa nyamukuru co gukwiza ubutumwabwiza mu mahanga yose.
name: Ivy’ukuzuka kwa Kristo n’igikorwa sigaranye abigishwa biwe

description: Bamaze gufata Yesu ngo baje kumucira urubanza ni ho Petero yahakana yuko yoba yaragendanye naYesuYuda na we uwagurishije Yesu aja kwiyahura. Yesu yahavuye acirwa urubanza rw’ugupfa n’aho ata caha yakoze. Abasoda b’Abaroma bamwambura impuzu bamwambika umwambaro utukura wo kubambwamwo, bamwambika igitsibo c’amahwa, bamukorera amabimenshi atovugwa
name: Ivyabaye bamaze kujana Yesu imbere ya Pilato

description: Muri iyro joro Yesu asangira n’abigishwa biwe kandi ni co gihe yatanguje ingaburo yera. Bukeye Yuda aramugurisha baramufata baramwica
name: Ivyabaye mw’ijoro buca babamba Yesu

description: Yesu abacira umugani w’urwamfu mu buro, umugani w’akabuto ka sinapi, ivyo vyose ngo bashishikare gutahura ivy’ubwami bwo mw’ijuru.
name: Iyindi migani isigura ivy’ubwami

description: Ikimenyetso ca c’umwana w’umuntu kizoboneka kw’ijuru ari n’ububasha n’ubwiza bwinshi. Bisabwa ko wokwama witeguye kugira ngo Yesu ni yaza ube uwo kujana na we. Umugani w’inkumi cumin a wo nyene ukwibutsa guhora witeguye. Ni co kimwe n’umugan w’ababikijwe italanto.
name: Izindi mburi zo kwama tugavye kuko tutazi umusi canke isaha.

description: Yesu yigishije atanga impanuro zitandukanye . Ati ntimugakoreshwe ivyiza no gushimwa n’abantu. Gusenga na ho nyene s’ukwiyamamaza. Yesu rero ni ho yigishije isengesha rya Data wa twese. Kwisonzesha s’ukwijirirwa ngo n’abandi babone ko ata co wariye. Ubu tunzi nyakuri na bwo ni ubwo mw’ijuru, nayo ubwo mw’isi burahera.
name: Kugororoka kw’abari mu bwami bw’Imana

description: Yesu yigishije yuko Imana itwitwararika ku buryo tutobura uko tubaho kandi turi abana b’Umwami mana yacu. Ati nyabuna tubanze twitwaririke ivy’ubwami bw’Imana n’ukugororoka kwayo, nayo ibindi tuzobihabwa nk’inyongera. Yabandanije yigisha ku ngorane z’uburyarya, iciza c’irembo rifunganye, gusaba twizeye, kwumva ijambo ry’Imana no kurikora.
name: Ntitukiganyire ku vyo kurya n’ivyo kwambara.

description: Ubwa mbere abanyabwenge b’inyenyeri bava I Buserukazuba baza kuraba aho yavukiye. Baramupfukamira bongera bamushikanira ingabire bazanye. Yesu ahungira muri Egiputa, Herode asigara arageseza abana b’abahungu bose b’I Betlehemu kugeza ku myaka ibiri, agira ngo Yesu yopfamwo. Herode amaze gupfa, umumarayika w’Imana yiyereka Yosefu ati subira I Nazareti, aca araduga uko abibwiwe.
name: Ubuhanuzi bwinshi bwari bwaravuzwe kuri Yesu bushika

description: Yesu Kristo yavyawe na Mariya uwigeme yari akowe na Yosefu mugabo ataramurongora. Bamubonye afise inda ya Mpemu Yera, Imana ituma umumarayika kumutegura ngo amenye ko azovysrs Yesu,Umukiza, avyakiraneza na Yosefu avyakira neza. Hanyuma avukira I Betelehemu ahantu hagayitse cane.
name: Ukuvuka kwa Yesu uko kwagenze

description: Mu binjiye mu bukwe habonekamwo umuntu Atari yambaye impuzu y’ubukwe. Baramuboha bamuterera hanze mu mwiza. Ico ni co kizoshikira abo bose bazoba banse kwizera umwana w’Imana. Abansi ba Yesu baraza bose bamugerageresha ibibazo arikoarabatsinda.
name: Umugani w’ubukwe bw’umwana w’umwami n’zindi nyigisho

description: Abasoda baramukubita biteye ubwoba, bamukorera amabi yose bagomba kugira ngongo bamumugaze imbere yo kumwica.Baca bamuremeka umusaraba baja kumubamba I Gologota. Arahambwa, abasoda barinda ima yiwe ngo abigishwa biwe ntibamwibe. , ariko arazuka nab o barahundagara bagwa igihumura.
name: Urupfu rwa Yesu

description: Herode yishe Yohana amiciye umutwe. Yesu akora iditangaza co kugaburira abantu 5.000 hanyuma agendesha amaguru hejuru ku mazi.
name: Urupfu rwa Yohana, n’ibindi bitangaza Yesu yakoze

description: Babonye Yesu agendera hejuru ku mazi bagira ngo ni igihume. Ariko arabaremesha, mbere Petero ati mbarira nanje nze aho uri. Armuhamagara na we nyene aragendera ku mazi. Yesu yashishikaye gukiza abantu benshi ariko abafarsayo n’abanyabwenge b’ivyanditswe bakomeza kumuranya.
name: Yesu agaya inyigisho z’abafarisayo kandi akiza abarwaye benshi

description: Bamuzanira umuhungu arwaye intandara aca akankamira idayimoni ikaze yamutera ivyo, aca arakira. Yongera kuvuga ko azohava yicwa, arahava yigisha ivy’umukuru mu bwami bw’ijuru ko ari uwuca bugufi nk’umwana muto.
name: Yesu akiza umuhungu arwaye intandara

description: Yesu akiza abantu beshi bazanywe barwaye. Ahaza abantu ibihumbi bine. Agaya inyigisho z’abafarisayo kuko yabona uburyarya bwabo.
name: Yesu akomeza gukora ibitangaza abansi biwe nab o bakomeza kumurwanya

description: Yesu amaze kwerekana abahirwe ab’ari bo aributsa abakristo ku ari bo munyu w’isi n’umuco wayo. Hanyuma ati sinaje gusenyura ivyagezwe naje kubishitsa. Yaciye igisha ku vyo kwica, gusambana, kwahukana, kurahira, kwhora. Arangiza avuga ko abiwe bakwiye kuba agahore mu kugirira neza bose, n’abakugiriye nabi.
name: Yesu ashishikara kwigishiriza ku musozi

description: Yesu amaze gusbanura umugani w’umubivyi aca abacira umugani w’izahabu n’imaragarita, n’umugani w’urusenga rutewe mu kiyaga rukayorora ifi nziza na mbi, umurovyi agaca yicara agakuramwo mbi akazita. Asubira Wabo I Nazareti, ariko yahakoreye ibitangaza bike kubera ukutizera kwabo
name: Yesu asobanura umugani w’umubivyi agashishikarakwigisha

description: Yesu aravuga ko agiye kuzoja I Yerusalemu agapfa. Abigishwa biwe bumvise ko iyo nkuru y’ugupfa kwiwe ibagumiye. Ariko vyari bikenewe kuko ni co cari camuzanye. Turabona ivy’ugukayangana kwiwe bari kumwe na Petero na Yakobo na Yohana.
name: Yesu avuga ivy’ugupfa n’ukuzuka kwiwe

description: Yesu abona umusukoni awuburako ivyamwa arawuvuma uruma. Abaherezi bakuru bamubaza bamugeza ngo ni ububasha ki bugutera gukora ivyo? Na we umubatizo wa Yohana wavuye hehe, ni mw’ijuru cankeni mu bantu, bati ntitubizi. Na we ati nanje ntaco ndabishura. Aca akomeza ababwira umugani w’abahungu babri, abarimyi b’abagarariji,
name: Yesu avuma umusukoni

description: Yesu yabujije abigishwa biwe gukurikiza inyifato z’Abafarisayo bashiraimbere imigenzo y’idini, Abo ni indyarya kandi bakunda kugirwako bwakeye. Abandanya yerekana ivyaha vyabo abereka yuko bazobona ibara.
name: Yesu yerekana yuko adashigikiye abafarisayo n’abanyabwenge b’ivyanditswe

description: Yesu azobwira abamugororokeye bagakora ibikorwa vy’urukundo ati ni muze abo Data yahezagiye muragwe ubwami mwateguriwe. Nari nshonje murangaburira, n’ibindi. Yesu azovuga ati ko mwabigiriye umwe muri aba bene Data bari hanyuma y’abandi nijewe mwabigiriye. Abaherezi bakuru n’abakuru b’Abayuda bafata ingingo yo kumusuka no bamwice.bikbananira. Ariko igihe kigeze baramufata baramubamba.
name: Yesu yigisha kuvyo gucira abantu urubanza

description: Abigishwa ba Yesu babandanya kwamamaza ubutumwa bwiza bw’ubwami bw’Imana. Yohana atuma abigishwa biwe kubaza kubaza ko Yesu yoba ari mesiya koko. Yesu ati genda mumubwira ko ari ko biri, ka impumyi zihumuka, n’abapfuye barazurwa. Yesu ashikara gushingira intahe ubuvugshwa bwa Yohana umubatizi, intumwa yo kumenyesha ivya Mesiya.
name: Yohana atuma abigishwa biwe kubaza ivya Yesu

description: Yohana umubatizi yabaye integuza ya Yesu. Inyigisho ziwe zari zishimikiye ku kwihana, ati “Ni mwihane kuko ubwami bwo mw’ijuru buri hafi”Ntawubatizwa atabanje kwihana ngo ave mu vyaha vyiwe. Yohana aravuga ati jewe mbatiza mu mazi ariko umuje inyuma yanje azobatiza mu mpwemu no mu muriro. Yesu na we yashingiye intahe ivyo Yohana yigisha. Araza kwa Yohana ati mbatiza nanje, Aramubatiza mu rusi Yorodani. Ahejeje kubatizwa ni ho Satani yaza kumugerageza ariko Yesu amutsindisha ijambo ry’Imana
name: Yohana Umubatizi yigisha akabatiza
